summary: Most of the frustration centres on loss of creative purpose and user experience, followed by overload of ads and ai-generated content and decline in content quality and relevance. Users report that the app is now dominated by ads and AI-generated content, making it hard to find real, relevant pins. Many feel the platform has shifted from a creative inspiration tool to an e-commerce and ad-driven platform.

themes.name: Loss of creative purpose and user experience
themes.description: Users who have used Pinterest for years feel it has lost its original purpose as a creative and inspirational platform. The app is now seen as less useful for creative exploration and more focused on monetization.
themes.recommendation: Revisit core user values, prioritize creative discovery, and restore the platform’s original mission.

themes.name: Decline in content quality and relevance

themes.name: App usability and design issues
themes.description: Users report that the app has become harder to use, with poor layout, confusing navigation, and intrusive ad placements. The app is perceived as less intuitive and more frustrating to use.
themes.recommendation: Redesign the app for better usability, improve navigation, and reduce intrusive ad placements.

themes.name: Privacy and content moderation concerns
themes.description: Users are concerned about the visibility of inappropriate or harmful content, including explicit material and harmful advice. There are also concerns about privacy, particularly with the use of AI and data collection.
themes.recommendation: Strengthen content moderation policies, improve transparency around AI usage, and enhance user privacy controls.
